sections.text: Introduction

The purpose of this document is to describe the
 various inspection /maintenance procedures (General Inspections), which must 
 be performed on weekly W1, monthly M1, and semi annual M6 intervals inspections are included in this document.

The aim of these instructions is to recommend a minimum 
 requirements for checks and inspections in order to maintain the reliability 
 of the fire fighting systems in the transformer yards. The detailed procedures 
 should be determined by the site engineers and / or the persons authorized. 
 All results of checks and inspections should be documented and / or reported 
 in formal sheets as indicated at the end of this document.
The first draft initiated by eng Reda Mohamed Ahmed ElRous at 12 Nov 2002 Assuit 500 substation, Middle Egypt zone
Safety Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Never
 perform any work on the transformer before isolating the fire protection
 system.

You
 must carry portable fire extinguisher when entering the transformer room
 after the fire.

Vent
 the flooded transformer room before entering it after the fire.

Any
 person inside the transformer room must immediately leave it after hearing
 the fire alarm.

Any
 doors leading to the room must be kept closed.

To
 prevent the accidental discharge of the system, do not touch the pilot
 cylinder weighing device inside the transformer room.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Weekly 
Check
Mechanical confirmations

Confirm 
the valving conditions (opening and close) of the water supply line by actually 
tracing the water lines and comparing with the system diagram (Dwg nos. FW 
86012 - 003 and FW-86012-004).

Confirm 
the water condition at the level gages provided at each tanks

Confirm 
the valving condition (opening and close) of the compressed air line by actually tracing the compressed air line and comparing with the system diagram 
mentioned above

Confirm 
the value of the pressure of the water line "ref. value 2kg/cm2" & compressed 
air in the tanks "ref. value 7.5 : 9 kg/cm2" by observing the pressure gages 
provided per each tanks

Confirm 
if the water storage tanks are filled with water

sections.text: Electrical Confirmation

Check the conditions of the lamps and switches on the fire control 
panels
Confirm the electricity supply (POWER SOURCE lamp lights)

Confirm the power source voltage with the voltmeter (apprx. 
380v)

Push the lamp test push button PB-L and make sure of the 
availabilities of all lamps on the panels (all lamps will light)

Confirm 
that all line break lamps and system fault lamp (s) do not light (orange lamps 
OFF)

Under normal condition, confirm that all fire alarm lamps and 
water discharge lamps are not lit (red lamps OFF)

Confirm 
that the high level lamp (for water storage tank filling condition) lights, and 
the low level is unlit.

In case that the low level lamp is lighted, fill the tank through the water 
supply valve by using the water wagon until the high level lamp is lit

The 
select switch COS is normally set to AUTO position, except when manual 
operation at control panel is adopted.
Confirm that the AUTO lamp is lit (WL 2 ON)

Confirm that the fault lamps for water pumps and air compressors 
are not lighted (orange lamps for pumps and compressors OFF)

When 
no compressor nor pump is under operation, confirm that all green lamps (for 
pumps and compressors) are lighted and all red lamps are unlit

Confirm that the red lamps for compressor and / or pump will be 
lighted, when operated.

Note: These pumps and air compressors are designed automatic operation, 
that will automatically start up when the water level and the pressure in the pressure tank 
decrease to predetermined values, and will stop when the level and pressure 
reach the predetermined values, automatically.
The operating pump (NO. 1 or NO. 2 ) and the operating air 
compressor (N. 1 or NO. 2) 
can be alternated by switching the selector switches for pumps and 
for air compressors.

Confirm if the lamps on all local manual starting boxes are 
normally lighted.

sections.text: Semi-Annual Check
Water Supply Pumps

Confirm the sufficient of the water supply pumps by isolating 
the inlet valve of the pressure tank, opening the test valve (1) at the pumps outlet, upstream of the 
orifice.

Then, turn the selection switch AUTO OFF-MANUAL to MANUAL Position, make sure that 
the pumps are operating smoothly without any abnormal symtoms (i.e abnormal sounds, 
abnormal temperature raising etc ...), the pumps can be test alternately by switching 
the selection switch No.1 No.2 for pumps. (on the front of the control 
pannel)

Repair 
and / or release all abnormality, if any

After 
confirming of the sufficient operations of the pumps, restore the water line as 
scheduled and turn the switches to normal positions for ready automatic operation

For further check and inspections, refer to the instructions of 
individual instructions per each equipment, if any, and the submitted 
Inspection Procedure

Points for Electrical Instruments

during transportation some instruments may be loosen, in this case some minor
